title: A voicemail message
instructions: Helen, Mark'a sesli mesaj bırakıyor. Kısa ama bilgi dolu; her kelime önemli. Değişen bilgilere dikkat et. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: helen
script.text: The meeting isn't on Tuesday now. It's on Thursday at a quarter past ten.

script.speaker: helen
script.text: It's in room twelve, not twenty.

script.speaker: helen
script.text: Bring the report, but not your laptop.

script.speaker: helen
script.text: And please call me before five.

questions.feedback: Toplantı artık salı değil (isn't on Tuesday now), perşembe (Thursday).
questions.evidence: It's on Thursday at a quarter past ten.

questions.feedback: "A quarter past ten" 10:15 demek. "Quarter to ten" olsaydı 9:45 olurdu.

questions.prompt: Which room is the meeting in?
questions.feedback: Oda on iki (twelve), yirmi değil (not twenty). İki sayı da geçiyor, olumsuzu dinle.
questions.evidence: It's in room twelve, not twenty.

questions.prompt: What does Mark need to bring?
questions.feedback: Raporu getirecek ama dizüstü bilgisayarı değil (but not your laptop).
questions.evidence: Bring the report, but not your laptop.

questions.feedback: Helen beşten önce (before five) aranmak istiyor.
questions.evidence: And please call me before five.
